items.title: Lonnie Liston Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 9, 2021
items.q: I was in high school when I heard Charlie Parker play “Just Friends” with strings over at someone’s house. That’s when I said well what is he doing?

ctx.x: It’s a bit of a miracle I guess. You attended music college. I wonder if you had intentions to be a music teacher?

No, but I’m glad — I went to, when I finished high school, Armstrong High School in Richmond, Virginia, because my whole family was always music. And my father was in a harmonizing Gospel group, the Harmonizing Four Gospel group. And so I was just surrounded by music from day one and then actually you said earlier, you’ve got that poster by you of Charlie Parker. I was in high school when I heard Charlie Parker play “Just Friends” with strings over at someone’s house. That’s when I said well what is he doing?…
Did they have any programs at that time that were — addressed jazz? Or were you more learning the classical theory and so forth?
